name: HiDrive Live-Workspace
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y rclone
postStartCommand: rclone config create hidrive webdav url=https://strato.com vendor=other user=$HIDRIVE_USER pass=$(rclone obscure $HIDRIVE_PASS) && mkdir -p ~/workspace/hidrive-cloud && rclone serve webdav hidrive: --addr 127.0.0.1:8080 & sleep 2 && sudo apt-get install -y davfs2 || true && mount -t davfs http://127.0.0.1:8080 ~/workspace/hidrive-cloud -o secrets=/dev/null
